node.label: India's neighbourhood
node.summary: India's ties with Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Maldives and other South Asian neighbours ('Neighbourhood First').

facts.text: Former Maldives Foreign Minister **Abdulla Shahid** (MDP) was arrested on sexual abuse charges. He was **President of the 76th UN General Assembly (2021-22)**. Maldives President: **Mohamed Muizzu**.

facts.text: Bangladesh garment workers' protests shut nearly **1,000** factories; they want a minimum wage of **30,000 taka** (now 12,500). The government blamed **Sheikh Hasina**.
facts.plain: Bangladesh garment workers' protests shut nearly 1,000 factories; they want a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (now 12,500). The government blamed Sheikh Hasina.

facts.text: The India-Bangladesh **Joint Rivers Commission** was set up in **1972**. The Ganga Treaty governs water shared at the **Farakka Barrage** (Murshidabad, West Bengal).
facts.plain: The India-Bangladesh Joint Rivers Commission was set up in 1972. The Ganga Treaty governs water shared at the Farakka Barrage (Murshidabad, West Bengal).

facts.text: The **Ganga Water Treaty** with Bangladesh expires on **12 Dec 2026**; MEA said the **Joint Rivers Commission** is the mechanism for cross-border rivers. India has invited Bangladesh PM **Tarique Rahman** to visit.

facts.text: Bhutan dedicated Chorten No. 76 of its **108 Buddhist stupas** (Jangchub Chortens), built in a nine-hour effort by 40,000+ volunteers, to PM Narendra Modi, as part of the India-backed Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC) project.

facts.text: Bangladesh's **Nahid Islam** (National Citizen Party) warned against an Indian **transit corridor** and sought fair water-sharing as the **Ganges (Farakka) Water Treaty** expires in **December**. The 30-year treaty was signed on **12 Dec 1996** (Deve Gowda, Sheikh Hasina).
facts.plain: Bangladesh's Nahid Islam (National Citizen Party) warned against an Indian transit corridor and sought fair water-sharing as the Ganges (Farakka) Water Treaty expires in December. The 30-year treaty was signed on 12 Dec 1996 (Deve Gowda, Sheikh Hasina).

facts.text: **Gelephu Mindfulness City** borders **Assam's Chirang** district, about 240 km from Thimphu. Bhutan's state religion is the **Drukpa Kagyu** school of Buddhism.
facts.plain: Gelephu Mindfulness City borders Assam's Chirang district, about 240 km from Thimphu. Bhutan's state religion is the Drukpa Kagyu school of Buddhism.

facts.text: Bhutan's **Project 108** (announced by King **Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk** on 26 Feb): **108 jangchub chortens**, each **15 m** tall, **108 m** apart along **12 km** of the **Mau Chhu** river in **Gelephu**, built on **1 Nov** (Buddha's Descending Day, Mother's Day, the King's **18th coronation anniversary**). Most relics are of Indian origin; each costs about **$200,000**.

facts.text: A Bangladesh court sentenced Awami League joint general secretary **Mahbubul Alam Hanif** to death in absentia for killings during the **2024 uprising**; the UN says about **1,400** were killed in July-Aug 2024.
